text:
Priya Patel: Heads-up — Aether Labs opened a dispute on their March Dedicated invoice. They say the burst charges coincide with an EU failover and are asking for an SLA credit. Can we confirm what triggered the overage?

Omar Khan: @Priya can you drop the invoice excerpt and the customer-reported timestamps? I can look at the pool logs.

Priya Patel: Sure — customer called out spike on 2026-03-12 ~02:10–02:20 UTC. Invoice excerpt below: 
```
Invoice INV-2026-03-582
- Reserved commit (monthly): $12,000
- Burst (overage): $3,640 (2026-03-12 02:14 UTC)
- SLA credit applied: $0
```

Mateo Rivera: Customer says they had an automated region failover from eu-west-1 -> eu-north-1 during a maintenance window; they claim we routed them to burst capacity instead of honoring reserved failover pool.

Alice Nguyen: Assigning this to billing to reconcile the line items vs meter data. BillingBot — can you pull usage for dedicated pool DL-219 for 2026-03-12 01:50–02:30 UTC?

BillingBot: Query received: pool=DL-219 window=2026-03-12T01:50:00Z..2026-03-12T02:30:00Z. Aggregated tokens: reserved_allocated=1,200,000; burst_tokens=320,000; anomalous_routing_flag=true. Full CSV export: /internal/billing/exports/INV-582_DL219_0312.csv

Omar Khan: Confirming logs show a control-plane routing hiccup at 02:12:13Z — failover flow created short-lived sessions that missed the reserved binding. Kernel traces: `route.bind(pool=DL-219)->timeout(240ms)->fallback_to_burst`. I'll paste the minimal log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-12T02:12:13Z] route.bind pool=DL-219 id=0x7f3 timeout=240ms
[2026-03-12T02:12:13Z] fallback to burst pool=DL-999 id=0x7f3
```

Priya Patel: That explains it. Customer is asking for SLA credit because the routing failure is our fault, not traffic surge. What credit would be appropriate?

Alice Nguyen: Per our SLA, if dedicated capacity is unavailable due to our routing error we offer a service credit up to the portion of burst charges caused by the incident. We need to calculate the fraction attributable to the control-plane failure window. BillingBot — can you compute the burst cost for tokens routed during 02:12–02:16 UTC and give a dollar amount?

BillingBot: Calculation complete: burst_tokens_in_window=180,400 -> burst_charge=$2,050. Estimated customer-impact fraction attributable to routing failure=0.88 -> recommended credit = $1,804 (rounded).

Mateo Rivera: Customer-facing note: propose 50% of recommended credit as immediate goodwill + the remainder after we complete a postmortem and confirm adjusted meter ops. Would that work for finance?

Alice Nguyen: We can do one-off goodwill of $900 immediately and then issue the remaining $904 as a bill adjustment after engineering sign-off. Need PR approval for the $900 credit.

Priya Patel: I'll draft the customer email once Omar confirms the postmortem timeline. Omar, can you estimate ETA for a short RCA?

Omar Khan: RCA draft by EOD tomorrow. Root cause: control-plane route bind timeout under increased control-plane latency during a local infra maintenance job. Mitigation: change bind timeout and add a pre-warm reserved binding on failover.

Mateo Rivera: Customer asked also to ensure future failovers don't hit burst. Can we add a config flag to pin reserved binding during cross-region failover?

Omar Khan: Yes — engineering change request created: ENG-1427. Short-term hack: prebind for 60s on failover. Long-term: route backpressure handling.

Alice Nguyen: Finance next steps: issue a one-time credit of $900 against INV-2026-03-582 and mark remainder pending. Ticket FIN-317 to record the manual credit and conditions.

Priya Patel: Thanks all. I'll send the goodwill credit note to Aether and attach the promised RCA ETA. :thumbsup:

Mateo Rivera: I'll follow up with the account team and log the customer's acceptance once emailed.

BillingBot: Manual credit action queued: amount=$900 invoice=INV-2026-03-582 status=pending_approval. Approver: finance-lead.

Priya Patel: @Alice Nguyen can you route the $900 approval today?

Alice Nguyen: Done — approved. Sending customer email now.

Omar Khan: Will post the RCA link here when ready.

Priya Patel: Closing loop — customer accepted the goodwill credit and requested RCA when available. We'll come back with the final adjustment after the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
